title: 5 March 1965: Filming: Help!, the Bahamas
content:
The Beatles returned to New Providence Island in the Bahamas on this day, following three days of filming Help! on Paradise Island and Rose Island.

They filmed scenes at a number of locations. Among the sequences were the scenes where John Lennon, Paul McCartney and George Harrison scour the island shouting for Ringo Starr.

Page last updated: 15 May 2010

Also on this day...

  • 2009: Release date for The Beatles: Rock Band announced
  • 2009: Paul McCartney to headline meditation benefit concert
  • 1999: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Konocti Harbor, Kelseyville
  • 1999: Recording: Brown Eyed Handsome Man, No Other Baby, She Said Yeah, Blue Jean Bop by Paul McCartney
  • 1996: US single release: Real Love
  • 1993: Paul McCartney live: Subiaco Oval, Perth
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Tokyo Dome, Tokyo
  • 1979: Mixing: Winter Rose by Wings
  • 1975: Recording: Listen To What The Man Said by Wings
  • 1973: Recording: Have You Seen My Baby, You’re Sixteen by Ringo Starr
  • 1971: Paul McCartney’s court hearing to dissolve The Beatles’ partnership – day eleven
  • 1970: Recording: Whispering Grass (Don’t Tell The Trees), Bye Bye Blackbird by Ringo Starr
  • 1964: Filming: A Hard Day’s Night
  • 1963: Recording: From Me To You, Thank You Girl, One After 909
  • 1963: Photo session in London
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Kingsway Club, Southport
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Casbah Coffee Club, Liverpool
